reference.observation: Ambient typography and explicit host direction align Native ConfigProvider. Source local OTP root/input/separator prefixes are ignored by cell wrappers/mask classes, which use the global namespace. Raw results remain unmodified; expectedNative uses a public inner ConfigProvider aligned with the local OTP prefix. Native retains independent global Input and local OTP namespaces and existing values, UTF-16 distribution, keyboard, refs, focus/selection, reset and SSR contracts.
